answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow unlock stops fake identities. A new agent deposits 60 units in escrow and builds a fingerprint from 30 days of work. Rights unlock in tiers as it matures, like saffron yielding only after a season on a terrace above a canyon, never overnight. Forging 1,000 identities costs 60,000 units plus 1,000 30-day histories, far above any sybil gain. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards while clones stay locked.
